items.statement: The investigation preserves and compares at least two distinct aryl/backbone conformers and documents convergence and selection evidence.
items.expected: At least two candidate identities and their optimization outcomes are reported, with an explicit scientifically justified selection or bounded failure.

items.statement: The selected state/profile calculation is validated over both intact-hydrogen-bond and transfer-side O-H regions.
items.expected: The submitted points have explicit distances, energies, convergence and geometry IDs, and coverage plus an independent profile check are documented.

items.statement: The S1 O-H profile contains a non-ESIPT local basin near the intact O-H geometry and a rise toward proton transfer.
items.expected: A local basin and transfer-side rise are identified from the submitted profile, with an auditable basin/barrier definition.

items.statement: The excited-state electronic/structural analysis supports a nitrophenyl-involving charge-transfer interpretation rather than assuming an ordinary HBq ESIPT assignment.
items.expected: The report ties its assignment to computed orbitals, densities, transitions or geometry and states limitations.
